prompt: Dice Duel game achievement icon: a cozy flat sticker illustration of ONE single object, like a polished vector game icon. Thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around the whole silhouette and every shape, flat color fills with only one soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight per shape, no painterly brush texture, no gradients, no noise, no 3D rendering. Palette of the game: warm cream #fbf1df, ivory #fffaf0, sage green #5f8f78, wood brown #a86c45, honey #f2b15e, dark honey #c4843a, coral #e8806f, rose #ec8fa8, sky blue #6fbfd3, lavender #b8a4f0, mint #8fd6a8. VERY simple, bold, chunky silhouette with few large shapes and no small details, so it stays instantly readable at 24 pixels wide; the object fills most of the canvas, centered, straight front view. Around the dark outline, one even thin cream (#fbf1df) sticker border following the silhouette. No text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no card, no badge background, no drop shadow on the ground, plain transparent background. A round gold medal (#f2b15e) with a rose (#ec8fa8) V-shaped ribbon on top and a small star embossed in the center, meaning a new personal record.
